name: F8 keys and modality
description: Phase 1 DoD fix F8 (audit S8, S9, S24 tooltips). A fixture project gets one resistor through the engine's execute_command IPC (SETUP). In the real window: with Design rules open (an aria-modal dialog) Ctrl+Z does not undo behind it and Ctrl+J does not hide the bottom panel; once the dialog is closed Ctrl+Z undoes. In Settings, Ctrl+Shift+T (the app shell's new terminal space key) is refused for an action with the reason; Bottom panel is then rebound to Ctrl+Alt+J by real key presses and the bottom panel's Hide tooltip, built from the key map, follows.
